method.length: Sum native GetLength of every trace by net/layer, including branches and trace portions overlapping pads. Pad copper is not added separately. Package/module routes and via barrel length excluded. Not electrical path-delay/skew.
method.reference_projection: Straight-track midpoint sampling of stored In1 GND fill plus GND pad/via copper; actual drilled-hole interiors excluded. In2 +3V projection for B.Cu reported separately. No refill or field simulation.
method.projection_arcs: Not sampled; flagged if present. Native length and geometry fingerprint still include arcs.
method.method_change_from_legacy_v1: Drill interiors explicitly removed from effective pad/via copper shapes; full per-net geometry hashes and transitive connectivity added.
method.geometry_fingerprint: Sorted native trace/via/pad geometries; UUID and serialization order excluded. At KiCad coordinate precision; pad rotation/size/shape/layers included. Not a complete filled-copper hash.

drc.limitation: Caller must provide the DRC produced from this exact saved board/project.

baseline_comparison.limitation: Legacy reports lack full fingerprints; equal listed metrics do not prove identical routes. Projection differences can also reflect fill or method changes.
